economy.name: Economy Food Plan
economy.description: Authentic local eateries, traditional thali joints, street food stalls, and bakeries. Wholesome regional flavors at modest rates.

sample_meals.breakfast: South Indian tiffin, idli/dosa, poha or parathas with chai (INR 120)
sample_meals.lunch: Vegetarian/regional mini thali or rice plate (INR 250)
sample_meals.dinner: Local diner meal, biryani bowl or roti curry (INR 230)

saving_tips: Opt for breakfast included at accommodation
Dine where locals eat for authentic dishes at half tourist prices
Carry refillable water bottles and dry fruit snacks

standard.name: Standard Dining Plan
standard.description: Mix of cozy family cafes, air-conditioned casual multi-cuisine restaurants, and local specialty bistros.

sample_meals.breakfast: Cafe continental breakfast or full traditional breakfast platter (INR 250)
sample_meals.lunch: Multi-cuisine seated lunch with drinks or dessert (INR 550)
sample_meals.dinner: Specialty dining at popular heritage or scenic restaurants (INR 500)

saving_tips: Take advantage of set lunch menus and combo platters
Reserve specialty dinners for 1 or 2 special evenings rather than every night
Explore afternoon snacks at bakeries instead of sit-down tea salons

comfort.name: Comfort & Fine Dining Plan
comfort.description: Premium multi-course dining, rooftop lounges, hotel gourmet buffets, chef specials, and seaside/hillview fine dining.

sample_meals.breakfast: Artisanal bakery espresso, smoothie bowl or lavish hotel buffet (INR 500)
sample_meals.lunch: Fine-dining heritage restaurant or coastal culinary experience (INR 1000)
sample_meals.dinner: Rooftop lounge multi-course dinner with specialty beverages and dessert (INR 1100)

saving_tips: Mix premium dinners with leisurely cafe lunches to maintain high culinary variety
Inquire about dining credits or package discounts at resort restaurants
Choose local estate-grown coffee and regional wines
